title: Problem details (RFC 9457)
description: Every non-2xx response uses application/problem+json with the ADEX extensions `correlation_id` and `errors`.

type.description: Stable problem type identifier, e.g. 'https://contracts.adex.dev/problems/no-eligible-alternatives'. Clients branch on this, never on the human-readable title.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation. Never contains internal identifiers, SQL, stack traces or another tenant's data.

errors.description: Field-level validation failures. Present for 422 responses.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the request body, e.g. '/eligible_alternatives/0/key'.
